answer: The whisper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the fable of a task receipt, and the echo is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
